architecture: per-frame linear+relu; residual blocks h += relu(conv1d(h)) (same padding, dilated, batch norm folded); per-frame linear to logits; class 0 is the CTC blank, greedy decoding
weights: float16 little-endian, tensors in the order above, row-major; conv weight is [out][in][kernel]
feature_spec: frames resampled to `fps` by nearest timestamp (ties to the earlier), at most `max_frames`; y scaled by height/width; per frame: left then right hand, 21x(x,y) minus that wrist divided by its wrist to middle-knuckle length (84); right wrist minus left wrist (2); each wrist minus the shoulder midpoint (4) and each wrist's step since the previous frame with that hand (4), these three in shoulder widths averaged over every frame with a pose; presence flags (2); a missing hand is zeros
dataset: ISL-Fingerspelling (ISH News, WSLP 2025, huggingface.co ISL Fingerspelling Dataset, CC BY-NC 4.0), signers 00 and 01; INCLUDE and Kaggle ISL word clips as non-spelling; landmarks by MediaPipe Holistic
